facts.consequence: create awaits SDK handler then returns handle; requestId random per call; codecs/interceptors/externalStorage can precede RPC; ALREADY_EXISTS is not proof of original intent
update describes and invokes synchronous transform, preserves existing headers, compiles replacement then sends without conflictToken; no application generation CAS guaranteed
create triggerImmediately hardcodes ALLOW_ALL; explicit trigger overlap is separate RPC; partial two-step effects must remain distinguishable
delete/pause/unpause/trigger/backfill are distinct operations; none proves workflow physically stopped
list traverses paginated namespace query and decodes memo/externalStorage; it supplies neither application tenant authorization nor finite total-output guarantee by itself
describe decodes action/memo and running/recent windows before projection; omission does not avoid upstream codec effects
cancel/terminate are separate; getHandle exact run vs first-chain ID vs latest differ; fetchHistory buffers every page, so output truncation alone cannot bound acquisition

default gRPC interceptor retries; deadline/abort apply at request creation, abort subscription does not precheck already-aborted signal; converter delay can precede RPC; no physical remote cancellation claim
workflowId and args have SDK defaults; remainingActions undefined means unlimited; adapter must bind explicit approved choices rather than silently inherit policy
catchup comment/default documentation conflicts; reviewed explicit integer value needed, no undocumented product default inferred

inventory.boundary: New application create; no legacy parity
Authorized application-owned listing/inspection and run-history projection; full event histories not assumed
Update and pause controls; current authority required
Cancellation with explicit separate running-run effects
